brief:
Knesset member Ahmad Tibi confronted Israeli comedian and reservist Guy Hochman over Hochman's claim that Tibi elbowed him in the face inside the Knesset, Eye on Palestine reported. The incident occurred after Hochman attempted to film a satirical video with Tibi.

Tibi denied the allegation during the confrontation. Details of the exchange and the circumstances leading to the alleged physical contact were not disclosed.
dek: Knesset member Ahmad Tibi confronted Israeli comedian and reservist Guy Hochman, who claimed that Tibi elbowed him in the face inside the Knesset after he attempted to film a satirical video with him.
title: Knesset member denies elbowing Israeli comedian
